title: Critical Early Moments: Foundations of Child Development and Growth up to One Year
description: A 10-day developmental pathway covering the most important principles of early development: sensory and motor sensitivities, attachment theory, Piaget’s sensorimotor stages, and the significance of parental responsiveness in building cognitive and emotional foundations. Based on UNICEF’s 'Early Moments Matter' report and CDC’s Act Early guidelines.

primary_reference.info: UNICEF Early Moments Matter (2017) + CDC Developmental Milestones + Vygotsky ZPD + Piaget Sensorimotor Stage
